title: Avalanche devnet: Primary Network
description: The Primary Network validators and their three chains: the P-Chain (staking, validator sets, and the registry of every L1), the X-Chain (assets), and the C-Chain (EVM contracts).

panels.title: Last Accepted Height
panels.description: The current block height: how many blocks have been finalized. A flat line means that the chain has no transactions, or that it stopped.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_snowman_last_accepted_height{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Accepted Blocks
panels.description: Number of new blocks accepted (finalized) in each interval.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Rejected Blocks
panels.description: Number of blocks that were proposed but ultimately rejected by consensus.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_rejected_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Processing Blocks
panels.description: Number of blocks currently in flight: received and being evaluated, but not yet accepted or rejected. A growing number means the node is not finalizing blocks.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_snowman_blks_processing{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Average Block Accept Latency
panels.description: The average time from when a block is first seen to when it is finalized.

targets.expr: sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_sum{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9

panels.title: Reject Rate
panels.description: The ratio of rejected blocks to all decided blocks (accepted plus rejected).

targets.expr: sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_rejected_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_rejected_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Successful Polls
panels.description: The share of Snowman consensus polls that reached a successful outcome. It reads 100% while the chain is idle.

targets.expr: (sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_successful{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) + 1) / (sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_successful{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_failed{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) + 1)

panels.title: Successful Queries
panels.description: The share of consensus queries that received a valid response (chits) instead of a failure. A drop means that peers do not answer this node. It reads 100% while the chain is idle.

targets.expr: (sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain", op="chits"}[$__rate_interval])) + 1) / (sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain", op="chits"}[$__rate_interval])) + (sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain", op="query_failed"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain", op="chits"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) + 1)

panels.title: Stake Benched
panels.description: The total weight of validators on the bench list: validators that this node excludes from consensus queries for a while, because they did not respond.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_benchlist_benched_weight{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Validators Benched
panels.description: The number of validators currently benched.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_benchlist_benched_num{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Polls per Accepted Block
panels.description: The average number of consensus rounds (polls) that finalize one block.

targets.expr: (sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_successful{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_polls_failed{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_accepted_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Outstanding Polls
panels.description: The number of consensus polls in flight: started but not yet resolved.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_snowman_polls{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Outstanding Block Requests
panels.description: The number of block fetch requests that were sent but not yet answered.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_snowman_requests{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Pending Jobs
panels.description: Consensus jobs that wait to run: blocks that wait for an ancestor before they can be issued.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_snowman_blocked{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Requests Failed
panels.description: Failed requests to peers, by kind. `query_failed` is a consensus query without an answer; the others fetch blocks or the frontier of the chain.

targets.expr: sum by (op) (increase(avalanche_handler_messages{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain", op=~".+_failed"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average Verification Time
panels.description: The average time to verify a block, successful and failed verifications together.

targets.expr: sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_sum{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9

panels.title: Block Verifications Failed
panels.description: The number of blocks that failed verification.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_meterchainvm_verify_err_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Non-Verified Blocks Pinned In Memory
panels.description: The number of blocks that were received but not yet verified, held in memory.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (avalanche_snowman_non_verified_blks{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"})

panels.title: Blocks Built
panels.description: The number of blocks that this node proposed.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blks_built{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Build Block Failures
panels.description: The number of times a node tried to build a block and failed.

targets.expr: max by (node, chain) (increase(avalanche_snowman_blk_builds_failed{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain=~"$chain"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Total Staked
panels.description: AVAX staked on the Primary Network, as the P-Chain records it.

panels.title: Validators
panels.description: Number of validators of each chain, as each node sees it.

panels.title: Active L1 Validators
panels.description: Number of active validators of all L1s, as the P-Chain records it. The setup of a Proof of Stake L1 adds its staked validators and then removes the bootstrap validators.

panels.title: Accepted Blocks by Type
panels.description: P-Chain blocks that were accepted, by block type.

panels.title: Accepted Transactions by Type
panels.description: P-Chain transactions that were accepted, by type. The deployment sends the transactions that create each L1 and register its validators.

panels.title: Node Uptime
panels.description: Uptime of each validator as its peers report it, weighted by their stake. A validator earns its reward above 80%.

panels.title: Accepted, Executed, and Settled Height
panels.description: The C-Chain executes blocks after consensus accepted them (streaming asynchronous execution). Accepted is the consensus height, executed is how far execution got, and settled is the height whose results a later block has recorded.

panels.title: Execution Queue
panels.description: Accepted blocks that wait for execution. A queue that grows means that execution is slower than consensus.

panels.title: Block Execution Time
panels.description: Average time to execute one block.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_evm_transition_sae_execute_block_duration_seconds_sum{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (rate(avalanche_evm_transition_sae_execute_block_duration_seconds_count{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Gas Charged Per Second
panels.description: Gas that executed transactions were charged, per second.

panels.title: Base Fee
panels.description: Base fee of the last executed block, in wei per gas.

panels.title: Transaction Pool
panels.description: Transactions in the C-Chain pool: pending ones can go into the next block, queued ones wait for an earlier nonce.

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Number of peers that each validator is connected to.

panels.title: Messages Per Second
panels.description: Network messages that the validators send and receive, over the selected nodes.

panels.title: Bytes Per Second
panels.description: Network bytes that the validators send and receive, over the selected nodes.

panels.title: Request Latency
panels.description: Average time until a peer answers a request of this node.

panels.title: Send Failure Rate
panels.description: Share of messages that a node could not send, as a moving average.

panels.title: Disconnects
panels.description: Number of times a node lost the connection to a peer.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores that each validator uses.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of each validator. The package limits a node to 1.5 GB.

panels.title: Database Operation Latency
panels.description: Average time of one database operation, by kind, over the selected nodes.

targets.expr: sum by (method) (rate(avalanche_meterdb_duration{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain="all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (method) (rate(avalanche_meterdb_calls{job="avalanche", role="primary", node=~"$node", chain="all"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9

panels.title: API Calls Per Second
panels.description: Calls to the HTTP API of the validators, by API. The deployment tools and the relayer call these.

panels.title: Failing Health Checks
panels.description: Number of failing health checks of each validator.

panels.title: Disk Available
panels.description: Free space on the disk that holds the database of each validator.
